Delivered by a Diamond Solutions Partner. Same scope, same outcomes, lower price.

Custom quote

HubSpot doesn't publish a standard Operations Hub onboarding rate — it's scoped per engagement. Quantum still applies the 25% discount to whatever HubSpot quotes. Includes data sync setup, custom code workflows, programmable automation, and data quality / governance.

Common questions

Is this the same onboarding HubSpot would deliver?

Yes. We deliver HubSpot's official onboarding scope as a Diamond Solutions Partner. You'd get the same configuration, the same training, the same handoff. The difference is we do the hands-on work for you instead of training you to do it, and we price at 25% off.

How is Quantum able to discount HubSpot's rate?

We onboard dozens of clients a quarter as a Diamond Partner. Volume and process maturity let us run onboarding more efficiently than HubSpot's internal team, and we pass that back to you. The discount is documented on every SOW.

Which hubs do you onboard?

All of them. Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, Service Hub, Operations Hub, Content Hub, and CRM Foundations. Starter, Professional, and Enterprise tiers. If HubSpot publishes onboarding for it, we deliver it.

How long does it take?

Standard onboarding runs 12 weeks, matching HubSpot's published timeline. Faster timelines are available on request and depend on scope, integrations, and stakeholder availability.

What if my needs go beyond standard onboarding?

We have custom implementation packages for that. Most clients start with Standard Onboarding and add custom work as the project develops. Talk to us during scoping and we will tell you what is in versus out.

Ready to scope your onboarding?

Book a 30-minute scoping call. We will walk you through your hub mix, send you exact pricing with the 25% discount applied, and outline next steps.

params.content: Does Your Organization Struggle With These Challenges?

• Systems fail to track equipment and other inventory accurately

  • Problems with prospecting new accounts

  • Hiring more salespeople when the current team isn't performing at a high level

  • Sales reps aren't getting and documenting the right insights during discovery calls

  • Quoting and ordering systems are time-consuming and often inaccurate

• Missing cross-sell and upsell opportunities that could lead to big revenue increases

  • Stalled deals in the sales pipeline get forgotten

  • Poor data hygiene in the CRM

  • Marketing and sales are misaligned and failing to communicate effectively

  • Marketing, sales, and client onboarding processes need to be streamlined and automated

Put These Problems Behind You for Good.

Our unique approach to HubSpot implementations will systemize, automate, and optimize your go-to-market strategy.

If you are looking into HubSpot as a solution for your company's growth challenges -- you are on the right track.

HubSpot is an amazing ecosystem of tools, but success depends on a few factors. You need a setup that addresses critical business challenges, a team that's willing to learn and collaborate, and a culture that strives to get to the next level.

We will set up your company with a streamlined, automated infrastructure that helps teams ensure clients stay engaged, sales reps identify and pursuee cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and stalled deals never get lost and forgotten.

Let us help you get more productivity from your sales and marketing teams today.

A Faster Track to ROI Than Any Other System Can Deliver.

Our plug-and-play system enables us to set up your portal and train your team in two months or less.
